criteria.behavior: Removal and downgrade rotate before canonical membership publication; failed rotation rejects strict and non-strict intents without mutating the member repository. Strict refounding uses the already-rotated epoch.
Required rotation failure blocks org encryption with OCKRotationPendingError, retains historical reads and isolates unrelated orgs; successful explicit or event-triggered rotation clears the guard.

Retry on later encryption requests with 1s-to-1m capped exponential cooldown; retain candidate key and removal exclusion. Wrap-only retries do not rotate or deliver to removed members. No retry timers or polling.
Pending rotation exposes degraded ock_rotation health with an org-specific message; EOSE readiness remains independent and recovery restores healthy status.

warm_start_limit: Exact recipient/registry comparison is not implementable reliably with existing OCKEnvelopeHistory (opaque handles/ciphertexts) and OCKMemberSource (current pubkeys only). There is no service-readable historical recipient roster. Runtime guards and retries are process-local; history query/missing service-wrap failures are not treated as permission to reset an epoch.
